title: ByteFS: System Support for (CXL-based) Memory-Semantic Solid-State Drives
problem: Memory-semantic SSDs expose both byte-addressable (via PCIe/CXL load/store) and block interfaces simultaneously, but existing software systems are designed for either NVM on the processor memory bus or block-interface SSDs, and cannot efficiently exploit the unique dual-interface characteristics and distinct performance profiles of memory-semantic SSDs.
motivation: Memory-semantic SSDs offer scalable, low-cost (NAND flash) byte-addressable storage capacity with CXL connectivity, but realizing their potential requires new OS/filesystem abstractions that understand their distinct byte vs. block access characteristics.
method: ByteFS is a file system designed specifically for CXL-based memory-semantic SSDs. It exploits the byte interface for metadata and small random accesses (latency-sensitive operations) while using the block interface for large sequential data transfers (throughput-sensitive operations), routing operations to the appropriate interface based on access pattern and size. ByteFS introduces new OS abstractions (allocation, caching, I/O path) that account for the asymmetric performance characteristics of the two interfaces and the persistent byte-addressable semantics provided by the device.
key_novelty: A file system that dual-routes operations between byte and block interfaces of memory-semantic SSDs based on access characteristics, with OS abstractions specifically designed for CXL-attached NAND flash memory semantics.
contributions: Characterization of memory-semantic SSD dual-interface performance and implications for software design
ByteFS file system with dual-interface routing of byte vs. block accesses
New OS abstractions (allocation, caching, I/O path) for CXL memory-semantic SSDs
limitations: Performance characteristics depend on specific memory-semantic SSD device implementations; generality across device firmware variants not discussed in abstract.
primary_theme: OS file system support for CXL memory-semantic SSDs
